criteria.requirement: Add --ignore-case to actual CSVGrep without stealing -i/invert-match. Preserve existing -m substring semantics using Unicode casefold on pattern/cell, -f whole-cell exact membership using casefold and regex mode using re.IGNORECASE (not regex casefold rewriting). Preserve default case sensitivity, any/all, inverse, header and short-row behavior; support empty regex and empty substring coherently. Keep output cell bytes/text unchanged and close match files. Demonstrate real utility output including Unicode casefold and regex-specific differences.
Deliver the authorized source changes, public regression tests that fail on the original version, and English compatibility documentation. All frozen native regression tests must pass.

comparison: Accept equivalent implementations according to actual program behavior; do not grade by matching reference text or its length.
